stem: During an environmental survey, one sensor is mounted directly in a dehumidifier discharge stream. How should that reading be used?
choices: Treat it as the room average
Flag it as a local equipment-influenced measurement and compare it with representative canopy locations
Average it with every other reading without noting location
Use it to reset all room setpoints
rationale: Sensor location determines what the reading represents; equipment discharge can create a local condition that should not be mistaken for the crop-wide environment.
